source.excerpt: Shared as a browser-driven helper for the person running a Skool group.

body:
## What it does

Sits alongside a Skool group you administer, working through an ordinary browser session instead of an official connector. It sums up who has joined and what has been posted, drafts follow-up messages for you to look over, and gathers the questions still without an answer into a list you can work through.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @shawnjooste shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
